notes: This contract pins the official C++ surfaces used by the focused two-dimensional, multi-attribute regional object matrix. The native test uses no-name regional registration, active regional subscriptions, ordinary Update Attribute Values, and the optional source-region callback carrier. It is a development-profile stress slice, not a claim that the broader DDM, timestamped, retraction, package, or conformance surfaces are complete.
